items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: That was the first time I had met Mutt.

ctx.x: And Mutt told him.... But this guy who owned this dance hall says, "Look, I don't care who he is. I don't care how good he plays that bass fiddle. I want a guy who plays tuba, too." And Papa Mutt naturally wanted George, for some reason, and he said, "Well, Pops Foster can play a tuba, too." So when George got to Los Angeles, he said, "Well, I can blow on one, a few notes." So Papa Mutt went and rented him one! And he played it so bad until the guy said, "Well, just let him play that bass fiddle and get rid of…
I've seen pictures of George Foster playing bass horn out here with somebody. Did he ever play bass horn that well?
